notes: Root cause was worse than enc_v15 §4 assumed: the field-overflow interaction has no continuation, so the resolver holding the parent's remaining steps (OP17-092 'then you cannot play Character cards this turn') was dropped, not merely ordered later. Fixed generally: any interaction raised inside an action now defers the rest of the effect's stack (as removal replacement already did) and it resumes before queued triggers.

Ordering rule implemented: triggers raised while an effect resolves wait in pending_triggers until the outermost effect finishes (Session resolving depth, journal-outside temp like effect_actor); drain after game_resolve_ability (after event flush) and settle_pending (deferred remainder first, then queue) after dialogs and at action/battle/turn boundaries. Rule basis cited as comprehensive rules 8-6-1 (auto effects triggered during an effect's processing activate after it); the repo has no rules text, so the article number/wording is from memory — please verify against the official CR.
Life [Trigger] stays immediate even during effect damage (part of damage processing, not an auto effect); only life-trigger items are processed while holding.
Effect PLAY_CARD of a character now honours CANNOT_PLAY_CHARACTER (with min_cost on master cost), same rule as hand play.

Out of scope, left as-is: own [On K.O.] (triggers::fire_on_ko) and [On Rest] resolve inline instead of via the queue; by the same rule they should wait for the current effect. Proposal: separate WP if wanted (would move goldens further).

Event log order changed: a child's EFFECT events are now emitted after the parent's (old engine logged the inline child first). 14/15 audit-golden and 11/17 replay-golden changes are this alone (states identical).

Arena 'after vs before wheel' cannot be played inside one game (one rules engine per game; two builds of the same extension cannot load in one process). Measured instead as the same 40 pairs played once per wheel and compared pair by pair: void 0 both, 37/40 identical results and turns, 1 game flipped. The wr ~0.63 is same-net seat/seed-set noise in both runs, not strength.
